question: Should receipt-bound publication and strict non-bypass ruleset verification become the permanent security and availability contract for repair and automerge?
rationale: Tests establish the mechanics, but only maintainers can accept the new credential trust model and its stricter fail-closed operational behavior.

options.title: Approve the boundary
options.body: Accept the current exact-head architecture as the permanent repair security model after normal final review.

options.title: Split the rollout
options.body: Land deterministic staged validation separately and review privileged publication and merge binding in a narrower follow-up.

options.title: Retain the existing model
options.body: Pause this redesign until maintainers choose a different security and availability contract.

recommendation.title: Approve the boundary
recommendation.body: Accept the current exact-head architecture as the permanent repair security model after normal final review.

likelyOwner.reason: The current-main and PR history show direct ownership of the proposed proof and publication boundary.
